title: HHS Administration for Children and Families program data (TANF financial and caseload data, CCDF expenditures)
agency: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Administration for Children and Families (Office of Family Assistance and Office of Child Care)
questions: how much each state spends of federal TANF and state MOE funds on basic cash assistance
share of TANF spending going to child care, work activities or administration by state
TANF funds transferred to the Child Care and Development Fund and the Social Services Block Grant
number of families and recipients on TANF by state and month
TANF caseload trend: average monthly families, adult and child recipients
CCDF expenditures by state and funding stream (mandatory, matching, discretionary, ARP)

manual.how: Always this route: acf.gov (acf.hhs.gov redirects there) answers every script, direct .xlsx links included, with an AWS WAF JavaScript challenge (HTTP 202, empty body), so nothing is fetched from here. In a web browser open the page named in INSTRUCTIONS.md and click the XLSX link: TANF financial data https://acf.gov/ofa/data/tanf-financial-data-fy-<year> ('FY <year> TANF Financial Data Tables (XLSX)'); TANF caseload https://acf.gov/ofa/data/tanf-caseload-data-<year> (the TANF, SSP-MOE or TANF & SSP-MOE caseload XLSX; the '15 Months' file when there are two); CCDF expenditures https://acf.gov/occ/data/child-care-and-development-fund-expenditure-data-list-all-years, then 'FY <year> CCDF Expenditure Data', then 'CCDF Expenditures for FY <year> (all appropriation years)' or a grant-year 'Tables 1b-...' page, then its XLSX link. Save the workbook and upload it as saved; --ingest reads the table named in the request.

cache.why: Small workbooks saved by the user; ACF replaces files in place when it revises them, so data/ is reused only within a run.

redistribution.why: TANF financial and caseload data and CCDF expenditure data are compiled and published by HHS/ACF, a U.S. government agency: works of the U.S. government are in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105).

citation: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Administration for Children and Families, {dataset} (acf.gov, workbook saved from the agency's site), retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which money: federal TANF funds, state MOE funds, or both? ACF tables show federal funds, state MOE (in TANF and in separate state programs) and all funds separately; transfers to CCDF and SSBG are federal TANF funds counted as used but not spent in TANF. The default is all funds (federal + MOE) with transfers reported apart.
Which caseload: families or recipients, and TANF only or TANF plus separate state programs (SSP-MOE)? The default is TANF families (average monthly number for the fiscal year).

Fiscal year or calendar year? All three datasets are by federal fiscal year (October-September); the 15-month caseload files also give calendar-year averages. CCDF is reported by fiscal year of spending (all appropriation years) or by grant year; the default is the fiscal year.
